column1: # Dependency catalog: how bootstrap.sh installs each dependency on each host. Only what the harness uses: add a row to bring another pack in.
# Tab-separated; '#' lines are comments. '-' marks a not-applicable ref/skills/note cell (keeps read -r from collapsing empty fields).
# ref: 40-hex commit that skills-method installs pin to (npx skills add <source>#<ref>).
# skills: '*' (all) or a space-separated list of skill names, each passed as its own -s argument.
# Host columns: native (host plugin install) | skills (npx skills -a <host> -g) | none (skipped, see note). omp is never skills (no npx skills target).
